_apa_ini: Channel results of the broad track split by the version of the QC gate that accepted their source query, plus a check of the hard-filter rows in the same pool.

gerbang_qc.v1-cps-gate: a query is accepted only when its top candidate reaches CPS 0.55 under the frozen DITS weights, so its acceptance depends on the reported scorer
gerbang_qc.benchmark_penuh: 1,412 queries through v1, 1,364 through v2, 2,776 in total

urutan_berkas_kueri.cara_baca: the miner reads queries.jsonl from the top and stops at the limit of 600 pairs; if the position of the last source query is below the first v2 position, the whole broad track inherits the v1 gate because of the file order, not by choice

hard_filter_track_luas.aturan: drop the candidates whose payload department is not the asker's, then check whether the asker's gold is the only gold of the group left
hard_filter_track_luas.catatan: this result follows from the mining rule and is not a finding: the gold is always in the book of the asker's program and the rival gold always in the book of another program

gerbang: the count per stratum matches the paper's count for every cell
label_source: deterministic (join of the row provenance to the qc.protocol of the benchmark query)
